claim: The second fiscal quarter of 2026 filing marked a record net income of $27.8B for Microsoft.
summary: The claim refers to Microsoft's fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2025), whose 10-Q/earnings release would occur in late January 2026. The model's knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before that filing was available, so there is no established evidence to verify a net income of $27.8B or that it was a record, and the claim cannot be confirmed or contradicted from pre-cutoff knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft reported net income of $27.8B for its second fiscal quarter of 2026 (quarter ended December 31, 2025).
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before FY2026 Q2 earnings (expected late January 2026) were published. No established pre-cutoff data defines this quarter's net income as $27.8B.

sub_claims.text: $27.8B was a record (all-time high) quarterly net income for Microsoft up to that filing.
sub_claims.note: Record-high status depends on complete historical quarterly net income and the unverified $27.8B value for Q2 FY2026. Without post-cutoff filing data, record status cannot be established.

sub_claims.text: The result was disclosed in Microsoft's second fiscal quarter of 2026 filing.
sub_claims.stated_text: The second fiscal quarter of 2026 filing marked
sub_claims.note: Existence and content of the Q2 FY2026 filing cannot be verified as of 2026-01-04 cutoff; filing occurs after cutoff.
